blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **придёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: He is sure that he will come.

exercises.why: **вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**провёл** — past tense (masculine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).
exercises.prompt: Did you have a good time in Vegas?

exercises.why: **переведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of перевести: perfective (imperfective partner: переводить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

**пришли** — past tense (plural) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**отойти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: отходить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

**разведём** — future tense (1st person plural) of развести: perfective (imperfective partner: разводить).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).
**зашли** — past tense (plural) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
exercises.prompt: I want you to come over.

exercises.why: **принесла** — past tense (feminine) of принести: perfective (imperfective partner: приносить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**наведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

**пролетели** — past tense (plural) of пролететь: perfective (imperfective partner: пролетать).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
**ушли** — past tense (plural) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**пришла** — past tense (feminine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**заводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of заводить: imperfective (perfective partner: завести).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
**ввёл** — past tense (masculine) of ввести: perfective (imperfective partner: вводить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**подводить** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: подвести).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
exercises.prompt: I don't want to let her down.

exercises.why: **уплывать** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: уплыть).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**наведи** — imperative (ты, singular) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).
**ушел** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**обошли** — past tense (plural) of обойти: perfective (imperfective partner: обходить).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: We have walked all around the lake.
